United Natural Foods, Inc. (UNFI) provides APIs for suppliers, retailers, and data partners to interact with UNFI's distribution network. The UNFI API suite includes the Harmony Core API for read-only access to supply chain data files, the Supplier Portal API for product catalog and order management, and EDI integration for automated procure-to-pay workflows.
